Definition: a tablet for writing (as bare); by analogy, a mirror (as a plate)
BiblicalUsage: gillâyôwn means table, tablet, mirror, flat shiny ornament. It turns up twice, in Isaiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I take gillâyôwn as it stands — table, tablet, mirror, flat shiny ornament — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
